newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar stays lower by close.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar stays lower by close.

text.p: White sugar futures stayed lower by the close on Wednesday in line with New York's raws weakness due to long liquidation.
The London market was barely traded earlier in the day and although some trade selling was noted the nearby values remained in a tight band.
"There was a bit of selling against the EU (tender) but there was good buying in the whites just before New York opened," said one.

"But since then there's been some pressure even though the premium has widened -- really we haven't moved that much," he said, noting premium selling at $69. May/May differential stood at $67.78 at Wednesday's close.
By the finish, May was down 90 cents at $307.20 and August fell $1.60 at $305.50, with May/August spread also widening to $1.70 from Tuesday's close of $1.00.
The day's turnover reached a scant 1,249 lots.
In physical news, Iran bought another cargo of white sugar at around $314.00, the same price as the cargo bought last week and from the same supplier.
